verdict: Organic presence is active; overdue program milestones remain the priority risk.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, your Google Business Profiles generated 391 combined actions — 12 calls, 282 direction requests, and 97 web clicks — with no paid media spend in place. Forte Precision Metals saw an 11.76% week-over-week lift in profile engagement and a 33% lift in search clicks, while Advance Grinding Services and O'Hare Precision Metals showed softer recent trends, down 20% and 42% respectively in the last 7 days, a movement we are watching closely. The more significant issue across all entities is a set of program milestones — CRM reconciliation, outreach sequence launch, and the web/SEO foundation fix — that have been overdue since August and September; these are the work that unlocks reactivation revenue and cold pipeline, and they are being escalated and resolved now. Next period you should expect the SEO and CRM blockers to clear, which will allow the outreach sequences and site reindexing to move forward.

watch_item.issue: Two Google Business Profile locations — Precision Ground Bars and Precision Ground Metals — received impressions this period but generated zero calls, signaling a gap between visibility and contact.
watch_item.fix: Profile listing content and calls-to-action are being reviewed this week to close that conversion gap.
